name: icon
title: Icon
description: Size inline icons through the component that holds them.
use: An svg, an img or an icon component inside a control or a line of text. The component around it sets the size and the drawing keeps its own stroke; hide a decorative icon with aria-hidden="true". The default set is Master Icons: pick its 16, 20 or 24 drawing by that size.

instead.when: The mark says that work is under way
The picture is a person or a team

classes.name: icon
classes.description: An inline icon sized by --icon-size, 1em outside a component, set slightly below the baseline

properties.name: --icon-size
properties.description: Width and height. The component that holds the icon sets it; without one it is 1em

properties.name: --icon-stroke
properties.description: Replaces the stroke width the drawing carries, in the units of its viewBox. Not set, the icon keeps its own width; fill icons are unaffected

properties.name: --icon-color
properties.description: Color of the icon. A component sets it to quiet or tint its icons; without one the icon takes the text color

example: <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 8L13 8"/><path d="M8 3L8 13"/></svg>
